name: University of Exeter

facts.text: The University of Exeter traces its history to 1855 and received its full University Charter in 1955; it is a Russell Group university.
Exeter has three main campuses: Streatham and St Luke's in Exeter and Penryn in Cornwall, plus a Truro site.
Exeter has 29,700 students from 150 countries, 7,360 staff and 195,000 alumni from 183 countries.
Exeter is ranked 136th in the 2027 QS World University Rankings and is one of only four Russell Group universities to hold Triple Gold in the 2023 TEF.
Exeter was ranked 4th in the 2024/25 BUCS Sport Rankings and describes its campuses as carbon-neutral.
